dashboard.title: Gateway Geo & Raw Traffic Explorer
dashboard.description: Gateway geo and request-level traffic explorer using raw Zuplo gateway fields for locations, routes, methods, IPs, status codes, throttling, and auth outcomes.

panels.description: Gateway request distribution by normalized client country from the raw Zuplo table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_country AS Country,
  count(request_id) AS requests
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND notEmpty(ifNull(client_country, ''))
GROUP BY client_country
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 1000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Geographic Request Distribution; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Geographic Request Distribution

panels.description: Raw request count from the Zuplo gateway table for the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(request_id) AS total_requests
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total Raw Requests; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Total Raw Requests

panels.description: Daily raw gateway request volume over the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(timestamp) AS date,
  count(request_id) AS daily_requests
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY toDate(timestamp)
ORDER BY date ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Raw Requests Per Day; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Raw Requests Per Day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
  count(request_id) AS requests
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(timestamp)
ORDER BY time ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Raw Requests Per Minute; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Raw Requests Per Minute
panels.description: Raw gateway request volume by minute for the selected time range.
Median, average, and p95 gateway latency from raw Zuplo telemetry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
  ifNull(quantileTDigest(0.50)(gateway_latency_ms), 0) AS median_latency_ms,
  ifNull(avg(gateway_latency_ms), 0) AS average_latency_ms,
  ifNull(quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms), 0) AS p95_latency_ms
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND gateway_latency_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(timestamp)
ORDER BY time ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Gateway Response Time; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Gateway Response Time

panels.description: Raw route paths ranked by traffic. Route group is included for quick aggregation context.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  route_path,
  ifNull(route_group, 'unknown') AS normalized_route_group,
  count(request_id) AS request_count,
  round(ifNull(100.0 * countIf(toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code) >= 400) / nullIf(count(), 0), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
  ifNull(quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms), 0) AS p95_latency_ms
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND notEmpty(ifNull(route_path, ''))
GROUP BY route_path, ifNull(route_group, 'unknown')
ORDER BY request_count DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top Raw Route Paths; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Share of raw gateway requests marked as rate limited or returned as HTTP 429.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    ifNull(
      100.0 * countIf(rate_limit_outcome = 'rate_limited' OR toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code) = 429)
      / nullIf(count(), 0),
      0
    ),
    2
  ) AS rate_limited_percentage
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Rate Limited Requests %; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Rate Limited Requests %

panels.description: Raw gateway requests by normalized response status code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
  response_status_code,
  count(request_id) AS requests
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND notEmpty(ifNull(response_status_code, ''))
GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(timestamp), response_status_code
ORDER BY time ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Requests by Status Code; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Requests by Status Code

panels.description: Share of raw gateway requests that were rejected by auth or returned as HTTP 401.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    ifNull(
      100.0 * countIf(auth_outcome = 'auth_rejected' OR toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code) = 401)
      / nullIf(count(), 0),
      0
    ),
    2
  ) AS unauthorized_percentage
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Unauthorized Requests %; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Unauthorized Requests %

panels.description: Raw gateway 4xx and 5xx response counts by minute and response status code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
  response_status_code,
  count(request_id) AS error_count
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code) BETWEEN 400 AND 599
GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(timestamp), response_status_code
ORDER BY time ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Error Rates by Status Code; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Error Rates by Status Code

panels.description: Raw gateway request share by Zuplo-reported latitude and longitude.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toFloat64OrNull(zuplo_latitude) AS geo_latitude,
  toFloat64OrNull(zuplo_longitude) AS geo_longitude,
  multiIf(
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 5, 1,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 10, 2,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 20, 3,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 30, 4,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 40, 5,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 50, 6,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 60, 7,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 70, 8,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 80, 9,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) < 90, 10,
    round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) <= 100, 11,
    0
  ) AS percentage_band,
  round(ifNull((count(request_id) * 100.0) / nullIf(sum(count(request_id)) OVER (), 0), 0), 2) AS percentage
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND notEmpty(ifNull(zuplo_latitude, ''))
  AND notEmpty(ifNull(zuplo_longitude, ''))
GROUP BY zuplo_latitude, zuplo_longitude
ORDER BY percentage_band
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Traffic Location Map; du=${__user.login}'
